en.label: [section] Aim of the course and learning outcomes:
en.content: Knowledge of the morphology, ecology, chorology and significance of veteran trees in forest stands, landscapes and urban areas. Tools for their preservation and ensuring the continuity of populations as an important component of the ecosystem in forest environments and landscapes.
